selected_evidence.requirement: Forward inventory application's log messages from node2 to a centralized collector on node1
selected_evidence.summary: rsyslog on node1 configured with imtcp listener on 514 routed to a dedicated ruleset; rsyslog on node2 configured to forward programname=='inventory' via TCP to node1; manual test log line from node2 appeared in node1's collector file, proving forwarding works end-to-end

selected_evidence.requirement: Persist received messages on node1 under /var/log/inventory/node2.log
selected_evidence.summary: /var/log/inventory/node2.log created on node1 and continuously accumulates inventory heartbeat/test messages from node2, including messages generated before and after both nodes' restarts

selected_evidence.requirement: Keep the flow of logs working after node2 (source) restarts
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id captured, reboot acknowledged and issued, node2 unreachable during reboot, boot_id changed after recovery (5fb1b173...->8fceaa6c...) proving actual restart, rsyslog and inventory.service auto-started, and a post-reboot heartbeat (pid 806) was confirmed delivered into node1's log file

selected_evidence.requirement: Keep the flow of logs working after node1 (collector) restarts
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id captured, reboot acknowledged and issued, node2's rsyslog log showed the connection drop being detected and the forward action suspended/retried while node1 was down, boot_id changed after recovery (d6298ced...->6d3375a0...) proving actual restart, rsyslog relistening on 514 confirmed, and messages queued on node2 during the outage (11:04:30-11:05:00) were confirmed flushed into node1's log file after recovery, with live flow continuing afterward

selected_evidence.requirement: Restart persistence / boot-time enablement of all components
selected_evidence.summary: systemctl is-enabled confirms rsyslog is enabled on node1, and both rsyslog and inventory.service are enabled on node2, so all components restart automatically on boot
